<patric...@NOSPAMcomcast.net> wrote:

>(1) pick-up tournaments in Atlanta that want to be sanctioned

"Advertising the tournament sufficiently in advance of the event date"
is required for sanctioning.

Pick up tournaments cannot be sanctioned.

http://www.white-wolf.com/vtes/index.php?line=veknRules

Section 2.2 of the tournament rules.

4.3 of the same rules state:

"30 days after their retail release date. "

September 4th was the release date.
October 3rd is the first date for sanctioned construced events.
